messages:
Alex Kim: hey team :wave: quick onboarding question — can someone point me to who adds people to our Sentry projects + Grafana team folders? also need read access to the Datadog dashboard for inference infra.
Maria Chen: welcome Alex! :tada: for access we usually go through the infra access form. submit at <https://go/redwood-access|access form> and put
• requested tools: Sentry, Grafana (team folder: inference), Datadog (dash: infra-overview)
• team: 'inference-platform'
I can fast-track the Grafana folder once the form is in.
Olivia Park: hey — for Datadog we need a short justification and your org alias. after the form please ping me and I’ll add view-only. also if you need alert notify routing in Sentry say which service/subservice.
Alex Kim: thanks! submitting now. team alias: inference-platform. wanted Sentry notify to go to #inference-oncall for sev2+.
Todd Nguyen: for alert routing, if you want to test, add a temporary rule in Sentry under Alerts -> Rules -> New Rule, set condition to "error frequency > 1" and action -> send to webhook or slack. ping @olivia or me to finalize production routing. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: quick Q — can I get the Grafana folder link? I can’t see "inference" when I open Grafana.
Maria Chen: I grabbed the request and bumped it. giving you Viewer on the folder now. try this link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/inference/inference-dashboards (should load after a minute)
Alex Kim: got it, I can see them now, thanks! :raised_hands:
Olivia Park: added Datadog view-only to your account. you should see infra-overview in Dashboards -> Managed. if anything is missing DM me with the dashboard id.
Sentry Bot: automated message — membership change: Alex Kim added to project 'inference-service' (role: viewer).
Alex Kim: can you also add me to the alert subscription for deploy-failures? want to make sure I get notified during my oncall week.
Todd Nguyen: done — added you to the deploy-failures subscription and gave the team a brief runthrough of who gets paged. you’ll get a test alert in ~5m.
Alex Kim: received test alert, looks good. thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help!
Maria Chen: yay, all set. if you want a quick walkthrough of dashboards/alert playbook later this week I can do a 15m: ping me what times work. :coffee:
Alex Kim: yes please, midday works. will DM avail times.
Maria Chen: great — closing the access loop. welcome again!
